description: Remove media files (photos, videos, voice notes, documents) from chats while keeping the messages and captions; chats show 'Media removed'. Only Neuron's copy — nothing is deleted from WhatsApp. DRY RUN by default: returns how many messages/files/bytes would go. Pass execute: true to run it (irreversible).

conversationIds.description: Limit to these conversations. Omit for the whole workspace.

execute.description: Actually remove. Default false = preview only.

mediaTypes.description: Only these media types (media clears only).

olderThanDays.description: Only messages older than this many days. Omit/null for all ages.

name: neuron_clear_media
title: Clear Chat Media
